flagship.title: Agentic Workspace
flagship.body: A personal workspace for each researcher that brings Research Assistant, Deep Research and the other tools together in one place, along with manuscript files and work history. The AI agent automatically calls the right Skills and MCP servers, such as the ThaiJO Search, Article, Journal, Author and Citation MCP servers, through the TCI MCP Gateway, and remembers your research context.
bullets: Powered by an AI agent: plan → delegate to subagents and tools → re-plan → synthesize a cited answer
Add new Skills, MCP servers and APIs through the Registry without changing the agent itself
Every answer cites the source articles in ThaiJO and international databases

flagship.title: Research Assistant
flagship.body: A conversational research Q&A assistant. Ask in Thai or English: hybrid search (keyword and semantic) finds evidence in ThaiJO articles and international databases (OpenAlex, Crossref, PubMed), and the answer cites a source for every statement (RAG). Ask follow-up questions and open the source articles instantly.
bullets: Answers only from the evidence it finds; if the evidence is insufficient, it says so plainly instead of guessing
See Thai and international research in one answer, labeled by evidence type (such as RCT) and confidence level
Hand a question off to Deep Research when you need an in-depth report, or save the answer in the Workspace

flagship.title: Reference Extraction & Validation
flagship.body: Upload a PDF or paste a reference list, and the system parses each entry into fields (author, year, title, journal, DOI), handling Thai-language APA and Vancouver citations, including Buddhist Era years. It then checks against ThaiJO and Crossref that each reference exists, is accurate and has not been retracted, before the manuscript reaches the editor.
bullets: Extract references from PDF, DOCX or pasted text
Check DOIs, years, journal names and retraction status
Help editors screen manuscripts before sending them to reviewers

flagship.title: Deep Research
flagship.body: Ask a single research question and the system plans the search, searches ThaiJO and international databases, reads the relevant articles and synthesizes a report with a citation for every statement. Authors can export it straight away as a draft literature review.
bullets: Shows the search plan so you can adjust it before it starts
Weights Thai articles in ThaiJO alongside international databases
Hands off to the Literature Review Tool to build comparison tables

flagship.title: Paper Explainer
flagship.body: Turns a ThaiJO article into a scrollytelling page with AI-generated Manim animations for key equations and concepts. It helps students and the general public understand research more easily and makes Thai research better known.
bullets: Paste a ThaiJO article link and get a story page ready to share
Manim animations are tied to the article's equations and figures
Use it for public outreach and as university teaching material

flagship.title: Research Atlas
flagship.body: A map of the Thai research landscape, built by clustering ThaiJO articles with embeddings and topic modeling. Circle size shows the number of articles, lines show links between topics and color shows the field. Zoom from the national overview down to the journals, authors and articles in each topic.
bullets: See Thai research across all {journals} journals in a single view
Click a topic to see related articles, journals and experts
Works with Emerging Themes to show how each topic grows over time

cards.title: AI Chatbot
cards.body: Answers general questions about ThaiJO and TCI around the clock on the website and LINE OA, drawing on official manuals, policies and announcements, such as submission steps, tier criteria and fees. (For research questions, use Research Assistant.)

cards.title: Reviewer Finder
cards.body: Helps editors find reviewers with matching expertise based on their publication and citation records in ThaiJO/TCI, and checks for conflicts of interest (such as co-authorship or a shared affiliation) and current review workload.

cards.title: Literature Review Tool
cards.body: Reads a selected set of articles, summarizes key points and research gaps, builds methodology comparison tables automatically, and helps screen articles following PRISMA steps for systematic reviews.

cards.title: Journal Finder
cards.body: Recommends TCI journals that fit a manuscript by scope, TCI tier (Tier 1–3), T-JIF, language and review time, and warns when a journal is not indexed in TCI or shows signs of being predatory.

cards.title: Author Finder
cards.body: Find collaborators, reviewers or experts on a topic by keyword among more than {authorsApprox} authors in ThaiJO.

cards.title: Emerging Themes
cards.body: Identifies growing research topics from publication and citation trends in ThaiJO, compared with global trends in OpenAlex, so researchers and funders can spot new opportunities.
